1.text: Ni iki gitumye abanyamahanga bagira imidugararo?N'amoko yatekerereje iki iby'ubusa?

2.text: Abami bo mu isi biteguye kurwana,Kandi abatware bagiriye inama Uwiteka n'Uwo yasīze

3.text: Bati “Reka ducagagure ibyo batubohesheje,Tujugunye kure ingoyi batubohesheje.”

4.text: Ihora yicaye mu ijuru izabaseka,Umwami Imana izabakoba.

5.text: Maze izababwirana umujinya,Ibatinyishishe uburakari bwayo bwinshi

6.text: Iti “Ni jye wimikiye umwami wanjye,Kuri Siyoni umusozi wanjye wera.”

7.text: Ndavuga rya tegeko,Uwiteka yarambwiye ati “Uri Umwana wanjye,Uyu munsi ndakubyaye.

8.text: Nsaba nzaguha amahanga ngo abe umwandu wawe,N'abo ku mpera y'isi ngo ubatware.

10.text: Noneho mwa bami mwe, mugire ubwenge,Mwa bacamanza mwe z'abo mu isi, mwemere kwiga.

12.text: Musome urya Mwana,kugira ngo atarakara mukarimbukira mu nzira,Kuko umujinya we ukongezwa vuba.Hahirwa abamuhungiraho bose.
